title: P-mac foundation: portable target policy and unattached dedicated cleanup contract
outcome: P-mac foundation: portable target policy and unattached dedicated cleanup contract
acceptance: Pure Windows, macOS and Linux target policies can be inspected and tested on any compiling host; unknown targets fail closed. Native Windows probing keeps cmd.exe /d /s /c echo TERMAL_PROBE_WAKE and the existing 2-second deadline and 4-KiB output bound unchanged.

The common dedicated-runtime cleanup-lease contract retains the exact backend Arc and RuntimeToken while held, preserves pending ownership on Unresolved or error, refuses shared Codex ownership, and rejects foreign-token or foreign-owner completion.

Platform adapters and the common cleanup contract remain unattached to production runtime lifecycle and M4 dispatch. This slice makes no native macOS execution, Unix process-group cleanup, real Mac O1 verification or remote/pilot-readiness claim; the parent's native-Mac criteria remain open.
Portable focused tests pass with host-recorded evidence for this child's exact input in its named source root.

The maintained five-stage full gate passes on the exact landing input, and an independent Codex/Claude read-only review pair on that input has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding; any unfixed Low is tracked separately.
